description: CLASSICAL DRAWING — the sub-world of art_design_drawing: the atelier fundamentals, giving the concept-graph descent a third rung below art_design_drawing.

microtheory.name: classical_drawing
microtheory.definition: The timeless atelier discipline of drawing from observation: gesture and life-drawing, the vanishing point and the horizon, hatching and negative space, the rule of thirds and the golden section.

concepts.name: gesture
concepts.definition: A quick drawing capturing the pose and movement of a figure.

concepts.name: negative_space
concepts.definition: The empty space around and between subjects, an active part of design.

concepts.name: vanishing_point
concepts.definition: The point on the horizon where parallel lines appear to converge.

concepts.name: hatching
concepts.definition: Parallel strokes building tone and shading in drawing.

concepts.name: still_life
concepts.definition: The depiction of arranged inanimate objects.

concepts.name: life_drawing
concepts.definition: Drawing the human figure from a live model.

concepts.name: golden_ratio
concepts.definition: The proportion (about 1.618) long held pleasing in composition.

concepts.name: rule_of_thirds
concepts.definition: Placing subjects on a two-by-two division of the frame for balance.
